STEP 4 WORKFLOW FILE

Upload this file to the repository at:
.github/workflows/tanking-meter-collector.yml

Do not replace or edit:
.github/workflows/send-commissioner-notification.yml

The workflow expects this GitHub Actions secret:
FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON

It also sets these non-secret values:
FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=tcwr-dynasty
SLEEPER_LEAGUE_ID=1328431789223477248

The workflow can be started manually from the GitHub Actions tab after
the secret has been configured. It is also scheduled every 15 minutes.
Scheduled GitHub Actions runs are best-effort and may be delayed.
